faqs.question: What services do you offer?

faqs.question: What are your operation hours?
faqs.reply: Our support team operates 24/7 to assist you with any questions or concerns. Feel free to reach out anytime!

faqs.question: How can I get in touch with you for further assistance?
faqs.reply: You can contact us via email at support@decoinks.com or through our website's contact form. We're always here to help you with your needs!

faqs.question: How can I place an order?
faqs.reply: To place an order, please visit decoinks.com, select the products you want, and follow the checkout process. If you need help at any step, just let us know!

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.reply: We accept various payment methods including PayPal, Zelle, bank transfer, Venmo, CashApp, and Apple Pay. You can choose whichever option is most convenient for you!

faqs.question: How do I make a payment?
faqs.reply: Once you complete your order on our website, you can securely enter your payment details during the checkout process. If you prefer a different method, let us know, and we can provide the necessary details.

faqs.question: Can I order in bulk?
faqs.reply: Absolutely! We offer bulk discounts on larger orders. Please let us know the quantity and details of your order, and we'll provide you with the best pricing options.

faqs.question: How do I order in bulk?
faqs.reply: To order in bulk, simply share the details of your desired products, including quantities, sizes, and designs. We'll prepare a special quote for you based on your requirements.

faqs.question: How do I upload my designs?
faqs.reply: You can upload your designs directly on our website during the order process. If you have any issues, feel free to reach out, and we'll assist you!

faqs.question: What is the minimum order quantity?
faqs.reply: For custom t-shirts, our minimum order is 5 pieces. However, for DTF transfers, there is no strict minimum order, and we usually print gang sheets to keep costs efficient.

faqs.question: How much are the DTF transfers?
faqs.reply: Our DTF transfer pricing is as follows: 22-inch (60 cm) film is $5.00 per foot, 16-inch (45 cm) film is $4.00 per foot, and 12-inch (33 cm) film is $3.00 per foot. Charges are based on the exact gang sheet length, so you only pay for what you need!

faqs.question: What is the price for t-shirts?
faqs.reply: For custom t-shirts, our prices typically range from $8 to $12 per shirt, depending on the final sizes, print placement, and garment style. Let me know your specific requirements, and I can provide a more accurate quote!

faqs.question: What is the total price for my order?
faqs.reply: To provide you with the total price for your order, I would need to know the specific quantities, sizes, and designs you are looking to order. Once I have that information, I can calculate the exact total for you!

faqs.reply: Currently, we focus on DTF printed apparel and do not offer hats. However, for 10 custom t-shirts, the price would depend on the sizes and designs. Please share those details, and I can give you a precise quote!
